name: FormWeb
title: visual website authoring for people and their agents
summary: FormWeb is a visual website builder with a Rust engine, a CMS, design systems, a vector editor and static export, driven from an editor or from agents over MCP.
lede: FormWeb is the Form family's visual website builder, researched against Framer and Webflow. One Rust engine owns the editable site, validation, history and static compilation, and the TypeScript editor and MCP clients operate that same document. Sites export as portable HTML, CSS and runtime ZIPs.
runs_on: macOS and Linux; Windows launchers are supplied but have not been run on Windows
checks: Builds pages from nested semantic elements with flex and grid placement, custom breakpoints and a live responsive preview of the exported site.
Keeps design systems: typed tokens, text presets, and components with properties, variants and slots.
Runs a CMS with typed relations, detail routes, queries, pagination and CSV round trips.
Exports portable HTML, CSS and runtime ZIPs, and publishes immutable local releases with promotion and rollback.

facts.dd: .fweb with portable history and assets, autosaved to SQLite
A Rust workspace owns the document, validation, history and export; FastAPI bridges it to the editor and MCP
26 languages, switched live from Settings > Editor language
Kept in ~/FormWeb in the desktop app; FORMWEB_DATA_DIR sets it for a checkout

chapters.title: Layout, tokens and components
chapters.text: Nested semantic elements, page duplication, flex and grid placement, custom breakpoints and a live responsive preview. Design systems add typed tokens, linked text presets, component variants and slots, and reviewed pinned libraries.

chapters.title: A vector editor in the page builder
chapters.text: Pen, Curvature, shape and Pathfinder tools, Live Corners, gradients, clipping and opacity masks, Shape Crafter, Fill Regions, Trace Image and Pin Warp. Paths are svg and path elements the engine validates and exports, so agents author them too.

chapters.title: A CMS, forms and local releases
chapters.text: Collections with relations, filters, sorting, sliders and tables, multi-step forms with file uploads and validation presets, and immutable local releases with redirects, inbox and signed webhook delivery.

features.title: Pages and layout
features.text: Nested semantic elements with flex and grid placement.
bullets: Custom breakpoints; the editing canvas draws the breakpoint picked from the list
Live responsive preview of the exported HTML and CSS in a sandboxed frame

features.title: Content and CMS
features.text: Typed relations and bindings with CMS detail routes.
bullets: Filters, sorting, a collection slider, tables, folders and manual ordering

features.title: Output and behavior
features.text: Portable HTML, CSS and runtime ZIPs.
bullets: Owned raster assets and reciprocal language links

features.title: Vector editing
features.text: Pen, Curvature, shape and Pathfinder tools with Live Corners.
bullets: Round, inverted or chamfer on any single anchor, non-destructive
Gradients, clipping and opacity masks, stroke align
Shape Crafter, Fill Regions, Trace Image and Pin Warp
Type on a path, blend, repeat, warp and distort

features.title: Projects and teams
features.text: SQLite autosave and portable project files.

features.title: Publishing and forms
bullets: Form inbox, retention, constraints and tracking
Multi-step forms with file uploads and validation presets

features.title: Connected services
features.text: Configurable adapters whose credentials stay on the server.
bullets: Deployment, domain, translation, fetch and commerce adapters
Separate visitor membership, consented analytics and experiments

features.title: Agent dock
features.text: Terminal tabs, a Claude button and a Chat pane in the editor.
bullets: Starts your Claude Code already connected to the editor's MCP tools
Chat pane streams Claude's answers and tool calls

features.title: Command registry
features.text: Every menu item, toolbar button and shortcut runs through one registry.
bullets: Agents list and run window commands, with an Allow or Deny prompt for risky ones

features.title: Desktop app
features.text: ./build_app builds it locally; no prebuilt binary is included in this release.
bullets: Checks, installs, builds and freezes the engine in one command
Runs without the FormWeb folder and keeps data in ~/FormWeb

parity.against: Framer, Webflow, Adobe Express and Canva
parity.summary: 79 researched website-builder capabilities, re-traced in code at v0.18.0: the score stays 77.5 of 79 (98.1%). The four other products are graded from official documentation, so their scores are lower bounds.

docs.install:
cd formweb
./formweb install
Windows: formweb.bat install
docs.agents: An MCP server on http://127.0.0.1:8240/mcp when Agents is enabled; the docs/AGENT_QUICKSTART.md guide covers setup.

topics.title: Quick start
topics.text: The editor runs at http://localhost:5240; ./formweb build and ./formweb serve give the compiled editor at http://127.0.0.1:8240.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: backend/.env sets FORMWEB_DATA_DIR, FORMWEB_AGENTS, FORMWEB_AUTH_TOKEN, FORMWEB_PORT and FORMWEB_ORIGINS.

topics.title: Architecture
topics.text: The README maps the Rust crates for the model, engine and export, the FastAPI backend and the frontend.

topics.title: Limits
topics.text: The README states that Windows, native desktop bundles and automatic skill activation remain unverified.

topics.title: Manual and parity
topics.text: docs/MANUAL.md, the Studio guide and the four-vendor comparison in docs/comparisons/ record the features and each release's score.

items: On Linux and Windows the window no longer shifts a few pixels after it opens, because it appears once its bundled Inter font has loaded
The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window when the .js file type is set to text/plain in the registry
The built window has a smoke test in CI: no console error, no failed request and no layout shift
The splash screen logo no longer jumps when the rest of the splash arrives
